Return the required JSON. forbidden_details means any letters/numbers/logos/watermark, or an occupant inside a vehicle; an isolated fictional portrait is allowed. For a car, true_top_down=yes requires roof planes only with no visible vertical side doors or front grille; heading_right=yes means its NOSE faces screen right. Use uncertain when evidence is insufficient. Confidence is one of 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1 (a fraction, never a percentage). It describes observations, not artistic quality. Brief kind: car. Replace the outermost quarter of the long pale RIGHT hood with ONE centreline electric harpoon launcher: a short dark rail and ONE hooked barbed pale steel spearhead, ending BEFORE the old hood tip. A single insulated cable follows the centreline from engine to launcher; its reel is tightly wound ON the chassis. No outside cable loop, no detached lightning, no second spear. Preserve the four tread-top wheels, narrow dark capsule cockpit, swept rear fins, worn bone/rust paint and long thin sprint proportions. Complete car fits between x=70 and x=940; empty magenta beyond every tip. No cast light or bloom. This is a new reference design, not damage or livery.
